title: Delivery whose package.json typecheck script fails, no typecheck command configured
why: The typecheck gate auto-detects the repo's package.json typecheck script when GAFFER_DOD_TYPECHECK_CMD is unset. Before, the gate was skipped as 'no command configured' on every repo and a failing typecheck shipped to review.
note: smallest-change: added removeTask to src/tasks.js and the typecheck script
